source: MetroList Prospector with Bay East data share, single-family closed sales over $1.5M, pulled 9/22/2026; 'came off the market' = Expired + Canceled in the same window

insights: Six in ten sales closed within thirty days, and those homes brought 99.5% of asking. The ones that ran past thirty days settled closer to 96%.
The listings that came off the market asked $2.63M on average. The homes that sold were listed at $2.13M on average. The gap was price, not demand.
Two out of three sales closed within thirty days, and those homes averaged 101.5% of asking. Homes that sat past sixty days closed near 96%.
For every three homes that closed over $1.5M, two came off the market unsold. The unsold group asked $2.98M on average against $2.78M for the homes that sold.
Homes that sold in the first thirty days averaged 102.7% of asking. After sixty days the average dropped to about 95%.
Listings that came off the market asked $2.16M on average. Listings that sold were priced at $1.93M on average and closed at a median of $1.76M.
Two-thirds of sales closed within thirty days at 99% of asking. The median sale was $1.86M, with South Livermore and Dublin Ranch homes leading the top of the range.

Eighty-three listings over $1.5M came off the market against ninety-eight that sold. The unsold group was priced about the same as the homes that sold, so presentation and plan, not just price, made the difference here.
Eight in ten sales closed within thirty days at an average of 102.7% of asking. The median home was on the market eleven days.
Even in the fastest market on this page, fifty-eight listings came off unsold. They asked $2.64M on average, against $2.40M for the homes that sold.
Only five homes closed over $1.5M this quarter, so treat these numbers as a small sample. Sales here took eighty-four days on average, about three times the East Bay pace.
Six listings came off the market unsold, more than the number that closed. Waterfront and acreage homes over $1.5M need a buyer pool from outside the county, and that takes a plan to reach.
